name: Daggerfall Unity
description:
Daggerfall Unity is an open-source recreation of The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall using the Unity engine. It brings the massive open world and deep RPG systems of the 1996 classic into the modern era with high-resolution graphics, smooth controls, and extensive modding support.

Features:
- Full widescreen rendering with modern graphics, enhanced lighting, and high-resolution textures
- Smooth first-person mouse controls with configurable keybindings and controller support
- Restored cut content and fixes for hundreds of bugs present in the original game
- Powerful modding framework supporting community quests, graphical overhauls, and gameplay tweaks
- Requires original Daggerfall game assets (freely available from Bethesda)
